s.zh: 一直做下去（材料够、条件满足就做）。
s.en: Keep doing it (whenever materials and conditions allow).

s.zh: 加一次。已有同类按次数的工作单时，在它上面加一次。
s.en: Add one. If a counted bill of this kind exists, adds one to it.

s.zh: 台子12格内有命匣，点上面的按钮选一个。
s.en: There is a phylactery within 12 cells; pick one with the button above.

s.zh: 台子12格内没有命匣。还没有巫妖时，先在「仪式」页排入巫妖仪式；已有命匣就把它搬到台子旁边。
s.en: No phylactery within 12 cells. Without a lich yet, queue the lich ritual on the Ritual tab; otherwise move the phylactery next to the altar.

s.zh: 在这里排入仪式、献祭、造物和植入物培育；工人按队列从上到下来台子做。造物唤醒与重塑的追加材料从全图吸收。
s.en: Queue rituals, sacrifices, constructs and implant growing here; workers take the queue from top to bottom. Extra materials for awakening and reshaping constructs are taken from the whole map.

s.zh: 工人按从上到下的顺序挑能做的工作单。「设置」打开原版的详细设置（执行者、材料筛选、搜索半径等）。
s.en: Workers pick the first doable bill from the top. "Settings" opens the vanilla bill details (performer, ingredient filter, search radius, etc.).
Conditions are not met right now.

s.zh: 没有符合条件的殖民者（尚未转化、心灵敏感度大于0）
s.en: No eligible colonist (not yet converted, psychic sensitivity above 0)

s.zh: 献祭、造物胚体与补给都服务于这里选中的命匣。命匣必须留在仪式台12格内。
s.en: Sacrifices, construct embryos and refills all serve the phylactery chosen here. It must stay within 12 cells of the altar.

s.zh: 选一位殖民者执行；被选中的人会成为巫妖。
s.en: Pick a colonist to perform it; the chosen one becomes a lich.

s.zh: 队列是空的。在上面点「排入」或「持续」。
s.en: The queue is empty. Use "Queue" or "Forever" above.

s.zh: 打开死灵仪式台面板：查看服务命匣与造物，按分类排入巫妖仪式、献祭、造物和植入物培育，管理工作队列。
s.en: Open the necromantic altar panel: see the served phylactery and constructs, queue the lich ritual, sacrifices, constructs and implant growing by category, and manage the work queue.
